constraints.explanation: The path must start and end at the supplied endpoints.
Every waypoint and segment endpoint must remain in map bounds.
Every segment must respect obstacle safety clearance.
Every waypoint coordinate must be finite.
The returned path must not exceed the configured waypoint limit.

description: Plan a collision-free path for one UAV from a fixed start to a fixed goal in a bounded static two-dimensional environment with optional risk zones.
objective: Minimize the configured weighted sum of length, collision, smoothness, risk exposure, and intermediate waypoint terms.
output: The best feasible start-to-goal UAV path represented by ordered 2D waypoints.
